title: Sound intensity and sound level
note: Derives intensity level and relates it to hearing. Use the pressure reference separately when computing SPL.

title: Wave interaction
note: Connect constructive and destructive superposition to the two-path room example. Ideal waves simplify a real room.

title: Microphone techniques for recording
note: Read the operating-principle and directionality sections. Frequency-specific polar plots matter more than the name of the pattern.

title: Analog and digital MEMS microphone design considerations
note: Follows the transducer and signal conditioning inside a miniature microphone. Device-specific interface details vary.

title: ADC and DAC
note: Chapter 3 treats quantization, sampling and reconstruction as separate operations. Useful before experimenting with resampling.

title: Convolution
note: Build a filter output from scaled, shifted impulse responses. The model assumes a linear time-invariant system.

title: The discrete Fourier transform
note: Use sine and cosine correlation to understand a spectral bin before using an FFT implementation.

title: Configuring the spectrogram
note: Connect window duration to spectral bandwidth. Its Gaussian window constants differ from the Hann-window lab.

title: Mel-scaled spectrogram
note: Shows how a power spectrum is projected onto a mel filterbank. Check centering, exponent and mel convention when reproducing features.

title: RFC 6716 · Definition of the Opus audio codec
note: Read the encoder modes and frame-duration rules to distinguish speech coding, transform coding and their hybrid.

title: Phonemic contrast
note: Use contrast in a language to test whether a sound distinction can change meaning. Symbols alone cannot establish contrast.

title: A practical guide to Hindi script
note: Consult the consonant distinctions in the teaching material. A writing-system example does not describe all varieties or spontaneous speech.

title: IndicVoices
note: Compare read, extempore and conversational collection across Indian languages. Check transcription coverage separately from total recorded hours.

title: Sequence modeling with CTC
note: Work through blank-separated repeats and the sum over alignments. The illustrations make independence assumptions visible.

title: Sequence transduction with recurrent neural networks
note: Read the joint acoustic and label-history lattice. A transducer architecture still needs a bounded-lookahead encoder to stream.

title: Listen, attend and spell
note: Follow the encoder, attention and autoregressive decoder as an alternative to a latent monotonic alignment.

title: Robust speech recognition via large-scale weak supervision
note: Study multilingual weak supervision and transfer tests. The offline objective does not specify a product's partial-result commit policy.

title: pyannote.audio
note: Trace segmentation, overlap and diarization through a practical toolkit. Diarization returns local speaker labels.

title: ECAPA-TDNN
note: Examine a speaker-verification embedding network. A similarity score needs domain-specific threshold calibration.

title: Natural TTS synthesis by conditioning WaveNet on mel spectrogram predictions
note: Separate acoustic prediction from waveform synthesis. The evaluation is tied to this particular system and data.

title: High fidelity neural audio compression
note: Study the streaming encoder, residual quantization and decoder. Good reconstruction and good linguistic tokens are different objectives.

title: Voicebox
note: A concrete conditional flow-matching speech model. Check which segments are given as context and which are generated.

title: Moshi · a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue
note: Trace two streams of discrete audio and the time-aligned text stream. Reported latency belongs to the authors' setup.

title: ElevenReader plans
note: Consumer import/listening allowances, playback features, download availability and billing cadence. Prices and entitlements can change by time and region.

title: ElevenLabs plans
note: Separate API/creator credits from the consumer reader subscription. Character charges depend on model and plan.

title: Piper local speech synthesis
note: Inspect local inference and voice configuration. Check the engine license and each selected voice's model card separately.

title: Kokoro-82M model card
note: Lists model size, voice assets and language coverage for offline synthesis. Compare pronunciation with your own text rather than assuming quality from parameter count.

title: LoRA · low-rank adaptation of large language models
note: Derives a low-rank weight update. Applying it to speech modules requires a target-layer choice and separate speech evaluation.

title: Fine-tune Whisper for multilingual ASR
note: A traceable reference for pairing 16 kHz waveforms with labels and evaluating WER. Use currently permitted data and record exact revisions.

title: FLEURS
note: Parallel read speech provides a controlled cross-language comparison. It cannot establish performance on spontaneous code-switching.

title: Gabriel Skantze · professional profile
note: Use the profile to locate conversational systems and turn-taking publications and verify authorship.

title: Hema A. Murthy · research
note: A route into speech signal processing and synthesis in Indian languages, including publications and student theses.

title: Shinji Watanabe · professional profile
note: Connect end-to-end speech research and reproducible ESPnet experiments through an institutional profile.

title: ESPnet speech processing toolkit
note: Use recipe manifests, stage boundaries and environment details to reproduce one component at a time.

title: Moshi source implementation
note: Trace a full-duplex speech model's codec and streaming loop. Verify model and implementation licenses and hardware separately.

title: Full-Duplex-Bench
note: Study operational definitions of backchannels, interruption and pause handling before interpreting aggregate scores.

title: Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5
note: Uses controlled overlap scenarios to isolate conversational behaviors. Synthetic playback and a live listener can react differently.

title: LongMemEval
note: Tests information extraction, temporal reasoning, knowledge updates and abstention across text histories. Audio provenance needs additional tests.

title: Voice activity projection
note: Predicts future joint voice activity from conversational audio. A probability of future activity still needs a product action policy.

title: VoiceBench
note: Probe voice assistants across acoustic variation and tasks. Clip-driven tests cannot measure every interactive recovery behavior.
